title: Koru Module Manifest
description: modules/<name>/module.yaml. Lets tooling and CI discover modules without knowing their stack.

name.description: Must equal the module directory name. Images are published as koru-<name>.

stage.description: Pipeline stage; selects which contract the module must satisfy (docs/module-contract.md).

owner.description: Owning team. Keep in sync with .github/CODEOWNERS.

status.description: placeholder = null implementation that only satisfies the contract.

stack.description: Informational: language/runtime used inside the image.

platforms.description: Platforms the published image is built for.
